entries.def:
ἀν-έχω 
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;] 
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), Mat.17.17, Mrk.9.19, Luk.9.41, 2Co.11.1; 11.19, Eph.4.2, Col.3.13; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), 2Co.11.1 with dative of thing(s), 2Th.1.4 (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, 2Co.11.20 absol.,…

ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Num.36.11 ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7.2; 9.6 א * ;] 
a cousin: Col.4.10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Jos.23.14 (בּוֹא), 1Sa.27.8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;] 
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Eph.5.4, Col.3.18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)

ἀν-ήμερος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἥμερο ), 
not tame, savage (MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.3.3.†
(AS)

ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;] 
a man, Lat. vir. 
__1. As opposite to a woman, Act.8.12, 1Ti.2.12; as a husband, Mat.1.16, Jhn.4.16, Rom.7.2, Tit.1.6. 
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co.13.11, Eph.4.13, Jas.3.2. 
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luk.5.8 ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Act.1.16 and esp.…

ἀνθ-ίοτημι
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;] 
__1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against. 
__2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, Mat.5.39, Luk.21.15, Act.6.10; 13.8, Rom.9.19; 13.2, Gal.2.11, Eph.6.13, 2Ti.3.8; 4.15, Jas.4.7, 1Pe.5.9.†
(AS)

ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: Psa.79.13 (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I Est.8.91, Sir.20.2, 3Ma.6.33 * ;] 
__1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.). 
__2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with). 
__3. C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): Luk.2.38 (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see…

ἄνθος, -εος, τό 
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;] 
a flower: Jas.1.10-11. 1Pe.1.24" (LXX) .†
(AS)

ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11.32, 4Ma.9.20 * ;] 
a heap of burning coals: Jhn.18.18; 21.9.†
(AS)
